interpretations.rule: First-three actual uses and current-turn history
interpretations.basis: Current primary uses 使用 rather than 打出; actual-use classification follows the native same-product card semantics. No dedicated current official FAQ was found.
interpretations.implementation: Capture at declaration, across all actors in the actual turn, before completion order can be changed by nested effects. Record exactly the first three basic uses, including a genuine self-provided Dodge used against Slash and a genuine self-rescue use. Exclude played Slash in Duel/BarbarianAssault, played Dodge in ArrowBarrage, supplied cards, and non-basic uses. A whole use occupies one slot even if it has repeated effects or extra targets. History exists while this skill is absent and resets with each actual turn; after-turn-ended printed cards do not alter the already-frozen turn.

interpretations.basis: Current full primary wording plus same-product supplementary explanation
interpretations.implementation: With fewer than two basic uses there is no reward. If both first users are the owner there is no reward. If exactly one is the owner, draw one actual deck entity regardless of whether a third exists. If both first users are other actors and a third exists, require a currently legal proactive use of that exact third effective basic kind. An unplayable Dodge or a full-HP Peach cannot be manufactured; no voluntary decline is offered when a legal copied use exists.

interpretations.rule: Exact third effective basic kind and native legality
interpretations.basis: Primary says 此本回合第三张使用的基本牌; preserving elemental Slash is also corroborated by the explicitly testing-based community formalization. Ordinary skill-use quota handling and last-known native transformation tracking are engine rule interpretations.
interpretations.implementation: Retain normal, fire, or thunder Slash separately. A genuine current-Slash-fire transformation is tied to its original use/action and freezes the resulting kind. The new own producer uses zero entities, no suit/rank/color, current distance and target prohibitions, native responses, damage, Peach recovery and Alcohol effect. It does not spend ordinary Slash or Alcohol allowances. It grants no distance bypass and cannot actively print Dodge. Optional view-as availability does not change the already-used card kind.

interpretations.rule: Started rights, source loss and typed actual ending
interpretations.basis: Engine issued-effect continuation inference, not an additional published FAQ
interpretations.implementation: A collected candidate alone retains no lost-source rights. Original live-source checks remain in force until a real binding has started. Exact ProgramBindingStartedEvent plus the actual DeferredTurnEnd current child proves that start. The owning ProgramSkillFrame freezes source generation, gameplay hash, actual turn, first-three snapshot, paid draw movement and current native origin. Paid draw/native children drain through genuine movement, health, dying and skill windows after source loss or death without paying twice; dead actors make no new choices. The original actual AfterTurnEnded cursor resumes once, including foreign turns whose turn owner died, without an extra phase or turn.

An actual Alcohol effect applied by this same ending copy expires after all actual-ending children, before the next actual turn. The beneficiary is taken from the native AlcoholApplied fact, so legal actor/target changes are respected and an unrelated later Alcohol application is not erased.

runtime.pendingOwnership: ProgramSkillFrame.AHuiNanJueman and nullable CardUseFrame.AHuiNanJueman, exact DeferredTurnEnd current child and native basic-use typed return; no global pending object or use-ID sidecar. All new event payloads contain scalars or scalar-only immutable origin records; the frame history is defensively copied.
